knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Looks clean is not a result. The uncertainty is recorded and the decision is referred.
Section 4.2.2 says such porous items should be removed or discarded.
A washable metal fixture is a hard surface. The other two are porous or semi-porous.

practicalCriteria: For mock material cards, the learner classifies each card as hard, semi-porous or porous and writes the referral for each porous card.
The learner explains, in writing, why an item that looks clean is still referred.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: A porous item is kept on appearance alone.
A chemical product is applied as a blanket treatment.
